svg.title: The season desk: what to do next, the bracket and what needs you (organiser, crew)
svg.text: 07 · The season desk: what to do next, the bracket and what needs you (organiser, crew)
Use case: the crew runs Demo Finals from one page, at 1600 px and on a phone: settle a dispute, chase a lobby code, follow every group

g.text: Teams of three, drawn · 9 teams · Arena North for groups, Arena South for the final
Settle the dispute in group E
Ask group D for a code
A dispute holds the next round; after the
alert delay the crew's phones are pinged.
Group E · the reports differ · 4 min

svg.text: The same desk: the next action as the
One band of crew actions; the first is what to do next, so a tired crew taps one button (L10).
Counts are live; a dispute or a missing lobby code turns its tile amber (E2).
The organiser's bracket is the public one with crew marks; Needs you is the queue, oldest first. Every act lands in History (O6).
